public.title: Deep Set II
public.description: input {value,path,replacement}; path is a nonempty safe string-key array and existing ancestors are objects. At the leaf, if current and replacement values are objects, shallow-merge their keys taking replacement conflicts; if both are arrays, concatenate them; otherwise replace the leaf. Missing leaf acts as replacement. Return a deep copy with this edit. This extends a deep setter specifically by leaf merging, with no recursive merge of conflicting child objects. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.

explanation: Resolve the path, then distinguish array concatenation, object shallow merge and replacement. O(input plus replacement plus path length) time and space. Functional tests check the documented adapter behavior; they do not enforce implementation technique or prohibit built-in APIs.
